blocks.text: CHARLOTTE, N.C — Matas Buzelis scored 24 points, Josh Giddey added 12 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists, and the Chicago Bulls handed the Charlotte Hornets their seventh straight loss 107-105 in an NBA Cup game on Wednesday night. Tre Jones had 10 points and eight assists for the Bulls, who escaped with their second straight win when Coby White’s off-balance jumper rimmed out at the buzzer.
